shortDescription: Manage volume on Unity storage system

options.name: advanced_dedup
options.description: Boolean variable, Indicates whether or not to enable advanced deduplication. Compression should be enabled to enable advanced deduplication. It can only be enabled on the all flash high end platforms. Deduplicated data will remain as is even after advanced deduplication is disabled.

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: The unit of the volume size. It defaults to C(GB), if not specified.

options.name: compression
options.description: Boolean variable, Specifies whether or not to enable compression. Compression is supported only for thin volumes.

options.name: description
options.description: Description about the volume. Description can be removed by passing empty string ("").

options.name: hlu
options.description: Host Lun Unit to be mapped/unmapped with this volume. It is an optional parameter, hlu can be specified along with I(host_name) or I(host_id) and I(mapping_state). If I(hlu) is not specified, unity will choose it automatically. The maximum value supported is C(255).

options.name: host_id
options.description: ID of the host to be mapped/unmapped with this volume. Either I(host_name) or I(host_id) can be specified in one task along with I(mapping_state).

options.name: host_name
options.description: Name of the host to be mapped/unmapped with this volume. Either I(host_name) or I(host_id) can be specified in one task along with I(mapping_state).

options.name: hosts
options.description: Name of hosts for mapping to a volume.

options.name: io_limit_policy
options.description: IO limit policy associated with this volume. Once it is set, it cannot be removed through ansible module but it can be changed.

options.name: is_thin
options.description: Boolean variable, Specifies whether or not it is a thin volume. The value is set as C(true) by default if not specified.

options.name: mapping_state
options.description: State of host access for volume.

options.name: new_vol_name
options.description: New name of the volume for rename operation.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: pool_id
options.description: This is the id of the pool where the volume will be created. Either the I(pool_name) or I(pool_id) must be provided to create a new volume.

options.name: pool_name
options.description: This is the name of the pool where the volume will be created. Either the I(pool_name) or I(pool_id) must be provided to create a new volume.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the volume.

options.name: snap_schedule
options.description: Snapshot schedule assigned to the volume. Add/Remove/Modify the snapshot schedule for the volume.

options.name: sp
options.description: Storage Processor for this volume.

options.name: state
options.description: State variable to determine whether volume will exist or not.

options.name: tiering_policy
options.description: Tiering policy choices for how the storage resource data will be distributed among the tiers available in the pool.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vol_id
options.description: The id of the volume. It can be used only for get, modify, map/unmap host, or delete operation.

options.name: vol_name
options.description: The name of the volume. Mandatory only for create operation.
